text: And just as We revealed to the prophets before you - O Prophet - We revealed to you a Qur'an from Us; you did not know before it what the previous scriptures were, nor faith, nor the divine laws? But We made the Qur'an a light for people, by which We guide whom We will among Our servants to the straight path. And you - O Messenger - indeed guide and direct, by Allah's permission, to a straight path - which is Islam - the path of Allah, to Whom belongs the dominion of all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; there is no partner for Him in that. Indeed, to Allah - O people - all your affairs return, whether good or evil, and He will recompense each according to his deed: if good, then good; and if evil, then evil.
